source: The One-handed skill governs the use of smaller weapons such as swords, daggers, war axes, and maces.
target: 「單手」技能掌握較小武器的使用，例如長劍、匕首、戰斧和釘錘。

source: The Two-handed skill governs the use of larger weapons such as greatswords, battleaxes, and warhammers.
target: 「雙手」技能掌握較大武器的使用，如巨劍、巨斧和戰錘。

source: The Archery skill governs the use of bows and arrows to attack from range.
target: 「箭術」技能掌握從遠距離使用弓箭攻擊的能力。

source: The Block skill governs the use of weapons and shields to defend against incoming attacks.
target: 「格擋」技能掌握使用武器和盾牌來抵擋敵人攻擊的能力。

source: Smithing is the art of forging weapons and armor from raw materials.
target: 「鍛造」是利用原材料鍛造武器和護甲的技藝。

source: The Heavy Armor skill governs the use of thick, protective armors like Steel, Orcish, Dwarven, Ebony, and Daedric.
target: 「重甲」技能掌握使用厚重、保護性強的護甲，如鋼製、獸人、矮人、玄曜石和魔族。

source: The Light Armor skill governs the use of light, flexible armors like Leather, Scaled, Elven, and Glass.
target: 「輕甲」技能掌握使用輕盈、靈活的盔甲，如皮革、鋼鱗、精靈和翠琉璃。

source: Pickpocketing is the art of stealing from an unsuspecting mark. Those who are skilled in Pickpocketing are more likely to succeed, and can steal items of higher value.
target: 「扒竊」是從毫不知情的目標身上偷東西的技術。精於此道的人更容易成功，也可以偷到更高價值的物品。

source: Lockpicking is the art of opening locks and finding hidden treasures. Those who are skilled in Lockpicking can open more difficult locks with fewer broken lockpicks.
target: 「開鎖」是打開鎖和尋找隱藏財寶的技術。精於此道的人可以在減少開鎖器的損耗情況下，解開更難的鎖。

source: Sneaking is the art of moving unseen and unheard, and striking from the shadows. Those who are skilled in Sneak can even hide in plain sight.
target: 「潛行」是悄悄無聲地移動並從暗處襲擊的技術。精於此道的人甚至可以在人群中隱藏。

source: Alchemy is the art of brewing magical potions and deadly poisons.
target: 「煉金術」是釀造魔法藥水和致命毒藥的技藝。

source: Speech is the art of persuasion and bartering. Those who are skilled in Speech receive better prices from merchants and are more likely to convince others to do as they ask.
target: 「口才」是一種作用於交易以及說服他人的技巧。那些舌燦蓮花的人能從商人得到更好的交易價格，也更容易說服他人按照他們的要求行事。

source: The School of Alteration governs the manipulation of the physical world. This skill makes it easier to cast spells like Waterbreathing, Feather, and Ironflesh.
target: 「變換系」學派掌握物質世界的操控技能。這項技能使施放水息術、輕羽術，以及鐵身術等法術更容易。

source: The School of Conjuration governs the reanimation of the dead and the summoning of Daedra. This skill makes it easier to cast spells like Bound Sword, Revenant, and Soul Trap.
target: 「召喚系」學派掌握死者復活和召喚魔族的能力。這項技能使施放長劍塑形術、屍儡驅使術，以及縛魂術等法術更容易。

source: The School of Destruction governs the harnessing of fire, frost, shock, and other volatile energies. This skill makes it easier to cast spells like Burning Touch, Frost Rune, and Thunderbolt.
target: 「毀滅系」學派研究如何運用火焰、寒霜、閃電，以及其他不穩定能量。這項技能使施放燃燒之觸、暴霜法印、雷電術等法術更容易。

source: The School of Illusion governs the manipulation of the mind. This skill makes it easier to cast spells like Silence, Invisibility, and Night Eye.
target: 「幻象系」學派掌握心靈操控技能。這項技能使施放靜默術、隱身術、夜視術等法術更容易。

source: The School of Restoration governs the manipulation of life energy. This skill makes it easier to cast spells like Fast Healing, Turn Undead, and Poison Bloom.
target: 「恢復系」學派研究如何操控生命能量。這項技能使施放高效治療術、驅邪術、毒海術等法術更容易。

source: Enchanting is the art of binding magical spells to weapons and armor.
target: 「附魔」是將魔法束縛在武器或是護甲的技藝。

source: You cannot play an instrument in combat!
target: 你不能在戰鬥中演奏樂器！

source: Mass Reanimation is still on cooldown.
